sloka: तौ इमौ शोक संतप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि ।त्वया परिगृहीतो अयम् अंगदः शास्तु मेदिनीम् ॥४-२१-९॥
transliteration: tau imau śoka saṁtaptau śanaiḥ preraya bhāmini ।tvayā parigṛhīto ayam aṁgadaḥ śāstu medinīm ॥4-21-9॥

translations.english: 'O fair sex Encourage these two griefstricken heroes (Angada and Sugriva) gently. Let Angada rule this earth under your protection.
